infobox.usage: Unlocks the Educational Building storage room on Reserve.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-AK key (RB-AK) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Educational Building storage room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: The room can also be entered without the key by jumping from the 3rd floor window on the door awning and entering from the window, not requiring this key.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - On a filing cabinet in the unlocked guard shack on the path to the radar station

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text:
- The lock is located in the School building (Black Bishop), in front of the helicopter.
- The door is at the 2nd floor, on the west side staircase of the building.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Two PC blocks
- Loose tech loot
- One Sport Bag
- Virtex programmable processor spawns
- Tetriz spawns
- Phased array element spawns
- Several ammo box spawns
- Golden 1GPhone smartphone spawns

sections.heading: Trading
sections.text: | Canister with purified water x2; Canister with purified water; +; Water filter x2; Water filter | → | Therapist; Therapist LL3 | → | RB-AK key; RB-AK key |
